caption: Figure 4: The overall architecture of Libra features unified GPU instances executing partitioned micro-requests, guided by a two-level scheduling for improved SLO attainment and resource utilization. Orange and blue colors denote the prefill and decode stages of each request, respectively.

templates.why_chosen: Two Local Scheduler lanes, each a colored Gantt of micro-request segments (orange prefill, blue decode) on a shared Time axis, sit beneath one Global Scheduler whose circled steps 1-7 close a partition-predict-route-feedback loop.
templates.what_to_learn: Split one long request bar into colored sub-segments (prefill orange, decode blue) at the exact token position it was partitioned, lay two such lanes side by side under one Time axis labeled Unified Instances, and close a feedback loop back to the scheduler above with performance metrics rather than leaving the loop implied.
